faqs.question: How long can Swagruha batter be stored?
faqs.answer: Our batter is best consumed within 1 to 2 days when stored in a refrigerator (2°C to 5°C) to enjoy peak fresh flavor and fluffiness.

faqs.question: Do you use any artificial preservatives or baking soda?
faqs.answer: No! Swagruha Batters uses 100% natural ingredients—Selected Rice, Premium Urad Dal, Fenugreek, and Pure Water. We never add preservatives, soda, or yeast.

faqs.question: What ingredients are used in your batter?
faqs.answer: We use carefully chosen parboiled and raw rice, top-grade whole white urad dal, and a pinch of fenugreek seeds for natural fermentation.

faqs.question: How should I refrigerate the batter?
faqs.answer: Place the 1 KG pouch in the main refrigerator shelf (not freezer) immediately after purchase. Always keep the pouch sealed tight.

faqs.question: Do you prepare fresh batter every single day?
faqs.answer: Yes! We grind and naturally ferment fresh batches every night so that fresh 1 KG packs are ready for morning shop purchases.

faqs.question: Where are your stores located and how can I buy?
faqs.answer: We have 2 store locations in Nellore. Simply visit our physical stores or call us directly. We do not provide home delivery.
